O.outcome_detail: translation throughput in tokens per second

cells.quote: The Qwen3.5-35B-A3B model achieved the most optimal operational balance. This is due to its efficient attention architecture and native compatibility with low-bit frameworks (such as FlashAttention-2 [9] via llama.cpp [10]), it operated stably near the 16 GB VRAM ceiling (∼13.4 GB) while maintaining a high throughput of∼28 tokens/sec.
cells.note: The comparison values are printed in Table 1: Llama-3-70B throughput ~8 tokens/sec and Qwen3.5-35B-A3B throughput ~28 tokens/sec.

This is due to its efficient attention architecture and native compatibility with low-bit frameworks (such as FlashAttention-2 [9] via llama.cpp [10]), it operated stably near the 16 GB VRAM ceiling (∼13.4 GB) while maintaining a high throughput of∼28 tokens/sec.
